0.title: Choose a character
0.description: Find a character you feel comfortable on and have fun with

1.title: Turn off Comms
1.description: Go to your settings and turn off voice chat and text chat. Chat will not be useful in lower ranks and will only serve to allow toxic players to mess with your mental

2.title: Find a backup character
2.description: Choose a second character you are comfortable with, in case your main character is banned or taken

3.title: Dont Swap
3.description: Once you have found a character you enjoy, it is best to not swap to try and counter the enemies, you will learn over time how to play against counters

0.title: Use Cover
0.description: Use whatever walls or obstacles are available to you to try and block or limit damage

0.title: Take High Ground
0.description: Try to position yourself on highground whenever possible

1.title: Side Angle
1.description: Do not stand near the middle or front of your team, try taking an angle off to the side

2.title: Stay Hidden
2.description: When moving around the map and not currently fighting, try to stay hidden from enemy view using walls and obstacles

0.title: Note Enemy Positions
0.description: Make mental notes of where as many enemy players are as possible throughout the match

1.title: Basic Target Priority
1.description: Target the player with the least health on your screen. Do not leave your position to chase, just shoot whoever on your screen has the lowest health (usually a damage or support)

0.title: Relax
0.description: Your aim will be much better in the long run if you remain relaxed. Keep all tension out of your arm and wrist

1.title: Smooth Motion
1.description: When you are aiming, try to focus on making smooth motions from point A to point B

0.title: Learn Character Kit
0.description: Go to practice range and learn what all of the abilities on your character do

1.title: Make Note of Movement Potential
1.description: Note your character's movement abilities and where you can get to in short periods of time, this will be important as you move up the ranks

0.title: Stay Alive
0.description: Your #1 priority on tank is to stay alive, you will be focused often on tank, so staying alive is key to success

0.title: Take Easy Kills
0.description: If a kill is easy, take it. If a kill is not easy, do not try to force it

0.title: Don't Focus Too Much on Healing
0.description: While healing is an important part of your kit, you do not heal enough to keep a whole team alive by doing nothing but healing, try dishing out damage and playing like a dps unless you need to heal
